'''Jonat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] and was one of [[Heol Girdun]]'s favorite undercover agents. She was assigned to guard former [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]]. She became friendly with him where she allowed Omas to use her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to speak with his [[Elya Omas|daughter]]. This allowed [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to record the conversation and use it to give [[Ben Skywalker]] the idea that Omas had killed his [[Mara Jade Skywalker|mother]] to kill Omas.
